headline: Local Tea Shop Owner Offers To Host High-Stakes Face-To-Face Debate Provided Both Sides Agree To Share A Single Packet Of Bourbon Biscuits
body:
In a bold move to facilitate the much-anticipated face-to-face showdown between state leadership and opposition figures, local chai stall owner Rameshwar ‘Chai-wala’ Sharma has officially offered his 4x4 foot pavement establishment as the neutral ground. Sharma, who has been running the ‘Modern India Tea Point’ for twelve years, insisted that the historic debate can only proceed if both high-ranking officials agree to split a single 10-rupee packet of biscuits without squabbling over who gets the one with the most sugar crystals.

“The politics of the nation can be solved, but the politics of the snack plate is where the real integrity lies,” said Sharma while pouring a fresh round of cutting chai. “If the government and the opposition cannot sit on two wobbly plastic stools and successfully negotiate the division of four biscuits, then the future of the state is surely in question. I have a perfectly good newspaper to serve as a tablecloth, and I promise not to eavesdrop unless they order an extra round of pakoras.”

Political analysts have noted that the neutral venue provides a unique set of challenges, particularly the requirement that participants must hold their own cups and avoid asking for extra ginger. While both camps have historically struggled with bipartisan cooperation, supporters suggest that the shared consumption of a slightly soggy biscuit might be the only diplomatic breakthrough the region has seen in decades.

Representatives for both the ruling party and the opposition were unavailable for comment, though local patrons confirm that the stall is already being reinforced with extra napkins in anticipation of a high-intensity session. Sharma added that he is willing to install a second, slightly less wobbly stool if it helps ensure the stability of the state's democracy.
caption: Nothing brings rivals together like a shared snack pack. Will they settle the debate over a round of cutting chai? ☕️🍪 #AyodhyaDebate #ChaiDiplomacy #PoliticsOfBiscuits (satire)
